title: Pan-Seared Chicken Hash
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dish that combines crispy chicken with a crunchy hash of potatoes and vegetables.
instructions: Season the chicken breasts with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the diced bacon and cook until crispy, about 5 minutes.
Add the chicken breasts to the skillet and cook until browned on both sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, heat the hash browns in a separate skillet over medium heat.
Add the zesty hash browns seasoning to the hash browns and stir to combine.
Once the chicken is done, remove it from the oven and let it rest for a few minutes.
Serve the chicken on top of the hash browns, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
